milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate near the cracked stone brick path and face it to observe it. Target is the middle of the path at (3, -1, 4). Max distance 16 blocks with 60° facing tolerance ensures the player is looking at the path.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate near the jungle fence gate on the south face of the hut and face it. Target is the gate at (7, 0, 4). Max distance 8 blocks ensures the player is close enough to clearly see the gate, with 60° facing tolerance.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate to the hut entrance and look inside to see the brown wool block on the floor. Target is the wool at (7, 0, 6). Max distance 5 blocks with 60° facing tolerance ensures the player is at or near the gate entrance looking inward at the wool.
